notes.content:
Dear players,

We originally planned to launch the game on April 25, but we’ve decided to postpone the release slightly — the new release date is April 30 at 10:00 AM (Beijing Time).

This decision wasn’t made lightly. It’s not because there’s anything wrong with the game — rather, we want to:

Further polish the overall user experience

Share the enthusiasm of over 150,000 players from TapTap with a broader audience

Time our Steam launch just right to help more players discover the game

🎯 If you haven’t added the game to your wishlist yet, now’s the time — your support means the world to us!
👉 Click here to wishlist（https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555630/_/）

We’ll be sharing more dev logs, in-game screenshots, and behind-the-scenes content over the next few days. You're also very welcome to join the discussion section and count down to the release with us!

Thank you so much!

— The Dev Team
